DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (Reiter's Syndrome)

While Multiple Sclerosis is a possibility, your specific combination of urethritis, asymmetric oligoarthritis, and recent sexual activity strongly suggests Reactive Arthritis. Before we finalize this, please perform a physical exam of your genital area and joints, and REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine_Culture, HLA-B27, and Rheumatoid_Factor.
